content: कुट्टिम {%a.%} Paved with small stones, decorated with mosaic. .{@-मः, -मम्@} .²1 An inlaid or paved floor, ground paved with small stones, pavement; कान्तेन्दुकान्तोपलकुट्टिमेषु <ls>Śi. 3. 44</ls>; <ls>R. 11. 9</ls>. ‘निबद्धा भूः’ <ls>Ak.</ls> निष्यन्दश्चन्दनानां शिशिरयति लतामण्डपे कुट्टिमान्तान् <ls>Nāg. 3. 7</ls>. .²2 Ground prepared for the site of a mansion. .²3 A jewel-mine. .²4 The pomegranate. .²5 A hut, cottage, small house.
